_note: One short clip per toy. Filenames must match the slugs below (videos/<slug>.mp4). Style is kept consistent so all eight feel like the same toy box coming to life.
_style: Soft 3D claymation / wooden-toy look, chunky simple geometric shapes, bright pastel studio background, cheerful preschool cartoon, big friendly googly eyes and a smile, gentle bouncy motion, no text, no words, no logos, 3-4 seconds.

clips.rocket: A cute toy rocket made of a red triangle nose, blue rounded-rectangle body, yellow triangle fins and an orange flame comes to life: it grows big googly eyes and a happy smile, wiggles with excitement, then blasts off with a puff of sparkles and zooms up out of frame. Soft 3D wooden-toy style, bright pastel studio background, playful preschool cartoon, no text.
clips.house: A cheerful toy house made of a yellow square, a red triangle roof, a purple door and a blue round window comes to life: it grows googly eyes and a smile, the door opens and winks, it does a happy little hop, then bounces off out of frame. Soft 3D wooden-toy style, bright pastel background, playful preschool cartoon, no text.
clips.train: A friendly toy train made of a blue rectangle body, a red square cab, a little chimney and two black round wheels comes to life: it grows googly eyes and a big smile, puffs cheerful smoke, then chugs happily across and off the frame. Soft 3D wooden-toy style, bright pastel background, playful preschool cartoon, no text.
clips.car: A happy toy car made of a red rounded body, a light-blue dome roof and two black round wheels comes to life: it grows googly eyes and a smile, bounces on its wheels, honks with a little sparkle, then drives off across the frame. Soft 3D wooden-toy style, bright pastel background, playful preschool cartoon, no text.
clips.boat: A cheerful toy sailboat made of a red hull, a tall mast and two triangle sails (yellow and blue) comes to life: it grows googly eyes and a smile, rocks gently on cartoon waves, then sails happily off the frame with a little splash of sparkles. Soft 3D wooden-toy style, bright pastel background, playful preschool cartoon, no text.
clips.caterpillar: An adorable toy caterpillar made of a green head and colorful round body segments (lime, yellow, orange, red) comes to life: it grows big googly eyes and a smile, wiggles its segments in a happy wave, then inches cheerfully off the frame. Soft 3D wooden-toy style, bright pastel background, playful preschool cartoon, no text.
clips.flower: A cheerful toy flower made of a yellow center circle and four pink round petals comes to life: it grows googly eyes and a smile, spins and sways happily as tiny sparkles float around it, then bounces off the frame.
